description.narrative: MONFEMNET was first established by a group of 16 women's NGOs as The National Network of Mongolian Women's NGOs with broadly stated goals of uniting the power of women's NGOs to influence development policies. MOMFEMENT envisions a society that provides for every person's equal right to live in dignity and freedom, without fear or oppression, develop their potential and determine their life-path in pursuit of happiness, regardless of gender/gender identity, age, religion, partisan affiliation, ethnicity, geographic location, sexual orientation, social status, race, culture, ability/disability and other factors. The grant will support the following specific priorities and activities: 1. Build organizational capacity on collective and inclusive leadership of board members, members and staff 2. Conduct intersectional feminist analysis of critical socio-economic issues faced by women, working mothers, young families etc. 3. Operational costs and Staff salaries
